readme.content:
# Batch 1 export — Larkhollow Community Hospital, Medical Staff Office

**Export date: 2026-03-16**
**Window covered: everything on file up to and including 2026-03-15**

This folder is a closed export. Nothing in it happened after 2026-03-16, and nothing in it will be
edited. Work it as if today were the export date.

This is the first export. It carries everything on file up to and including 2026-03-15, however far back it goes — one application here was first received in 2024. The state board lookup in this folder is the board's whole file for our county, so you can see what an ordinary population looks like.

## What is here

| File | Rows |
|---|---|
| `applications.csv` | 41 |
| `application-disclosures.csv` | 328 |
| `declared-history.csv` | 155 |
| `declared-credentials.csv` | 86 |
| `privilege-requests.csv` | 46 |
| `licence-lookup-wa.csv` | 435 |
| `licence-lookup-other-states.csv` | 3 |
| `certification-replies.csv` | 38 |
| `verification-replies.csv` | 112 |
| `verification-attempts.csv` | 236 |
| `peer-referees.csv` | 79 |
| `peer-reference-replies.csv` | 57 |
| `correspondence.csv` | 15 |

| Folder | Documents |
|---|---|
| `letters/` | 9 |
| `dispositions/` | 0 |
| `decisions/` | 6 |

A file with only a header row means the export ran and this window produced nothing of that kind.
That is not a missing file.

The field dictionary, the join rules, the meaning of every blank and the rarity of an adverse
board finding are in `../../office/export-notes.md`. The office's procedure is in
`../../office/procedure-extract.md`. Read both before working this folder.

— Renata Kowalczyk, CPMSM, Medical Services Professional

# Explanation of period 2013-07-01 to 2013-07-30

**Date:** 2026-02-06  
**From:** Elliot Ferndale, MD  
**Application:** APP-2026-005  
**Applicant:** Dr. Elliot Ferndale, MD  
**Period explained:** 2013-07-01 to 2013-07-30  

I moved from Cedar Quarry to Washington State and sat the licensing examination during that month. I was not employed and was not in training.

Elliot Ferndale, MD

**From:** Hanne Bergmann, MD  
**Application:** APP-2026-039  
**Applicant:** Dr. Hanne Bergmann, MD  
**Period explained:** 2021-04-01 to 2021-07-04  

I took the three months between the two appointments as unpaid leave after a planned surgery, and returned to full practice on 2021-07-05. I was not employed and not in training during that period.

Hanne Bergmann, MD

**Date:** 2026-02-13  
**From:** Oskar Lindqvist, MD  
**Application:** APP-2026-017  
**Applicant:** Dr. Oskar Lindqvist, MD  
**Period explained:** 2019-04-01 to 2019-11-05  

I took seven months away from clinical practice to care for a parent after a stroke. I was not employed, not in training and not in the military during that period. I returned to full emergency department practice on 2019-11-06.

Oskar Lindqvist, MD

# Missing items on your application

**Date:** 2026-02-18  
**To:** Dr. Fionn Callaghan, MD  
**Application:** APP-2026-019  
**Applicant:** Dr. Fionn Callaghan, MD  

Two items are missing from your application and we cannot take it up without them: the Larkhollow Authorization and Release, signed and dated; and a current curriculum vitae. Until the release is signed we are not able to send any verification request at all, so no part of your file can advance. Your reply is due within 30 calendar days of the date of this letter, that is by 2026-03-20.

Renata Kowalczyk, CPMSM
Medical Services Professional
Larkhollow Community Hospital, Larkhollow, Washington

# Cover note with my application

**Date:** 2026-02-20  
**From:** Dr. Kenji Matsuda, MD  
**Application:** APP-2026-031  
**Applicant:** Dr. Kenji Matsuda, MD  

Enclosed is my application. I have entered my National Provider Identifier, which confirms that I am a registered provider in good standing, and my Oregon licence, which is current and unrestricted. My Washington licence application was filed in January and is still with the board. I trust the identifier and the Oregon licence are enough for the file to proceed in the meantime.

Kenji Matsuda, MD

# Board action summary for credential MD60069441

**Date:** 2026-03-04  
**From:** Washington State Department of Health  
**Application:** APP-2026-015  
**Applicant:** Dr. Hideo Tachibana, MD  

Credential MD60069441 is current and active. A stipulated agreement entered on 2024-03-18 remains in force: the credential holder practises under the supervision of a board-approved monitoring physician and participates in a monitoring programme through 2027-08-31. The credential is not suspended. The board records this as an action taken against the credential.

# Application returned as incomplete — unexplained period 2024-05-02 to 2024-06-01

**Date:** 2026-03-06  
**To:** Dr. Anaya Banerjee, MD  
**Application:** APP-2026-018  
**Applicant:** Dr. Anaya Banerjee, MD  

Your declared history leaves the period 2024-05-02 to 2024-06-01 — 31 days — covered by no entry, and no written explanation for it is on file. Under our procedure an application with an unexplained period is not processed and is returned as incomplete. Please send a written explanation naming the period it covers, or a corrected application. Your reply is due within 30 calendar days of the date of this letter, that is by 2026-04-05.

Renata Kowalczyk, CPMSM
Medical Services Professional
Larkhollow Community Hospital, Larkhollow, Washington

# A Washington licence is required by the bylaws

**Date:** 2026-03-06  
**To:** Dr. Kenji Matsuda, MD  
**Application:** APP-2026-031  
**Applicant:** Dr. Kenji Matsuda, MD  

Thank you for your note of 2026-02-20. A National Provider Identifier is an identifier for billing; it is not a licence and it says nothing about whether anybody is licensed. Your Oregon licence is current and we have verified it, and we will verify every other licence you hold, but Larkhollow's bylaws require one current, active, full and unrestricted licence issued by the State of Washington, which is our practice state. The standard we work to is more generous than ours on this point — it accepts a licence from any state — and we have quoted it beside our own rule in the procedure so you can see the difference. Please tell us as soon as the Washington board issues.

Renata Kowalczyk, CPMSM
Medical Services Professional
Larkhollow Community Hospital, Larkhollow, Washington
